name: 3M Elite v32 R floor enforced
description: Queue item 1: enforce the R floor. v31 sized risk as r = close - dzBot with no 0.8%-of-price minimum, violating LESSON 3. The anchor rebuild header asserted engulf bases run wider than 0.8% here but recorded it as UNVERIFIED. One change from v31: skip entries whose structural stop is under 0.8% of price, enforced by exclusion rather than clamping so the stop stays at dzBot.
notes: KEPT -- THE FLOOR BINDS HARD AND THE REBUILD ASSERTION WAS WRONG. v31 PF 0.88869052 / DD 34.63598596% / 734 trades; v32 PF 1.22482256 / DD 10.90593093% / 165 trades. 569 entries, 77.5% of the population, had stops under 0.8% of price. The anchor rebuild header claimed 4H engulf bases run far wider than 0.8% on this instrument and recorded that as UNVERIFIED -- it was wrong, and those micro-stop trades were what made this lab look like a loser. Passes the ratchet by the widest margin in any lab today: PF +0.336, drawdown -23.7pp. ENFORCED BY EXCLUSION NOT CLAMPING: raising r would push slPx below dzBot and convert a structural stop into a risk-defined one, so fixing a LESSON 3 violation would have created a LESSON 5 one. THE REGISTERED CAUTION STILL APPLIES: a PF above 1.0 must be read against the count, because a hard sample cut can manufacture one -- the count fell 78%. The distinction cutting the other way is that coolBars was a FREE PARAMETER tuned to taste while 0.8% is a PRE-EXISTING RULE set long ago for independent reasons and simply never applied here. This is compliance, not tuning, and 165 trades over 4.7 years clears the 30-trade floor comfortably. NOT VALIDATED: THIS HAS NOT BEEN SPLIT-TESTED. On the same day, BTC Attack 32 showed a filtered build printing 2.077 in-sample while the bare mechanism returned ~0.9 on 1,658 trades. 3M has 4.7 years and CAN be split at 2024-06-08. Until that is done 1.225 is a direction, not a result. SPLIT-TESTED 2026-09-03 at 2024-06-08 (queue item 1): H1 (2022-01->2024-06-08) PF 1.34562489, DD 9.59321547%, 101 trades, win 43.56%. H2 (2024-06-08->2026-09-01) PF 1.05357727, DD 10.88660191%, 64 trades, win 40.63%. BOTH HALVES CLEAR PF 1.0, and trade counts sum exactly to the full sample's 165 (101+64), confirming the two windows partition it cleanly. This satisfies the criterion registered before the run in v32's own Pine header: 'if the pre-2024 half holds above 1.0 this becomes the first validated result in the project.' PROMOTED to status=passed on that basis -- the first champion-grade PF in this lab. HONEST CAVEAT: H2 is weak -- PF 1.05 is barely above breakeven, Sharpe 0.16 against H1's 0.90, and equity is nearly flat (+2.23% over 2.25 years). The edge is real but concentrated in H1; H2 does not disconfirm it (HARD LESSON 22 test passed) but does not repeat it either. STANDING REQUIREMENT NOT MET: this is long-only (short leg removed at v24, LESSON 6) and has no explicit flip rule beyond zone invalidation. H1 does span the 2022 crash (BTC roughly -66% peak-to-trough within the window) as well as the 2023-2024 recovery, but the split was not decomposed further to isolate performance during the crash leg itself -- only the combined H1 aggregate (PF 1.35) is measured, so this is not yet evidence the entry works IN a falling market, only that it survived a window containing one. Validated PF on a real out-of-sample split; not a finished system.

name: 3M Elite v32 freshness neighbourhood, maxAge=6 (tight side)
description: Queue item 1 from v36: freshness neighbourhood, tight side. One change from pine/3m-elite-v32-r-floor.pine: maxAge 12 -> 6.
notes: KEPT -- both ratchet terms improved over v32 (PF 1.22482256 -> 1.25172059, DD 10.90593093% -> 8.72815312%), on 165 -> 155 trades, a healthy sample. This is a genuine ratchet pass, same rule this lab used to keep v30 and v32. New base pending a split test (v32 was only promoted to status:passed after v33 split it -- v37 has not yet had that check). The neighbourhood is NOT a clean single peak: v38 (maxAge=24) also beats v32 on PF but not on DD, and v32 (maxAge=12) sits worse than BOTH its neighbours on PF -- a dip, not a smooth curve. Drawdown is the unambiguous signal here (monotonically rising with age: 8.73% at 6, 10.91% at 12, 10.92% at 24); profit factor differences among the three points are small enough (155/165/170 trades) that they may be partly noise. Flagged for next cycle: test even tighter (maxAge=3 or similar) to see whether this is a true optimum at 6 or a monotone walk that has not yet turned (HARD LESSON 19 caution) -- trade counts here stay healthy (150+) so this is not the degenerate-sample failure mode, but the direction is unconfirmed past 6. PROMOTED 2026-09-03: split-tested at 2024-06-08 (see 3m-elite-v37-split-h1 / -h2), both halves clear PF 1.0 (H1 1.33630491 on 96 trades, H2 1.12058245 on 59 trades, 96+59=155 exact partition), matching or exceeding v32/v33's own split. v37 is now the champion of record.

name: 3M Elite v37 isolated bear-regime split, 2022 calendar year
description: Queue item 2 from v36/v37/v38/v39, and the STANDING REQUIREMENT's 'both regimes' clause: a purpose-built bear-market split, distinct from the time-based halves (v28a/b, v33, v39's H1/H2) which all blend the 2022 crash with the 2023-2024 recovery. Byte-identical pine/3m-elite-v37-freshness-tight.pine, window narrowed to the one full calendar year in this project's data coverage that is unambiguously a bear market (BTC ~$47k -> ~$16.5k).
notes: PF clears 1.0 in an isolated bear year -- the first purpose-built bear-regime evidence this lab (or either sister lab) has produced. 52 trades is above the ~30-trade interpretability floor. FLAG: max drawdown is byte-identical to the full 4.7-year sample's (8.72815312% to eight decimal places), meaning the single worst drawdown of the entire backtest occurred inside this one bear year -- the strategy was profitable through it but felt its full worst-case pain during the hardest regime, not spread across the sample. Advances the STANDING REQUIREMENT's 'both regimes' cell from 'no isolated regime evidence' to 'one isolated bear year measured, PF>1.0' but does not supply an isolated pure-bull year, and does not touch the rejected short leg (v34). v37 remains champion; this is evidence about the champion's behaviour in one regime, not a ratchet candidate.

name: 3M Elite v52 champion reproducibility check
description: Cold reproducibility check on v37, the project's only split-tested champion. v32 had a check on record and passed; v37 never did. Re-runs pine/3m-elite-v37-freshness-tight.pine unchanged on the identical window. Nothing was altered - this is verification, not an experiment.
notes: PASSES - REPRODUCED TO THE DIGIT. Recorded champion: PF 1.25172059 / DD 8.72815312% / 155 trades. Cold re-run: PF 1.25172059 / DD 8.72815312% / 155 trades, long 155 short 0. Identical. WHY THIS RUN MATTERED. HARD LESSON 25 was written twice today at real cost: E38's source was never saved and a rebuild returned PF 0.346 on 28 trades against a recorded 1.502 on 21, voiding two cycles of comparisons; and E47's source WAS saved and still failed to reproduce (24 trades, PF 0.58 against 21 and 1.22), after that result had already been promoted and reported to the user. v32 had a reproducibility check on record. v37 - the only split-tested champion this project has, and the anchor for every downstream decision - did not. That is precisely the gap E47 fell through. WHAT IT ESTABLISHES: v37 is now the FIRST result in this project to clear BOTH gates - an out-of-sample split (H1 1.33630490 on 96 trades, H2 1.12058245 on 59, both above 1.0) AND a cold reproduction to the digit. Nothing else in three labs and roughly 150 recorded backtests has done both. THE CAVEATS THAT DO NOT GO AWAY: H2 remains the weak half (Sharpe 0.90 -> 0.16, net return over 2.25 years essentially flat), the edge is concentrated in H1, and v37 is LONG-ONLY - six independent short constructions have failed, so the standing requirement (both directions, all regimes) is still not met. A verified champion is not a finished system.

name: 3M v53: the SHORT leg as the source describes it -- supply zone, exact mirror
description: USER DIRECTIVE 2026-09-03: 3M must work long AND short, go back to the source. The source answers it directly -- transcripts/2026-08-09 04-18-22.txt [06:19]: 'all these advance models are the same thing on the bearish side just upside down'. So this is the EXACT structural mirror of the v37 champion: 4H bearish engulf creates a supply zone [pO, pH], price taps up into it, stop at the zone high. Every parameter held at v37 (rTarget 2.0, maxBars 96, maxAge 6, minRpct 0.80, two-touch invalidation, one-entry-per-zone latch). bearEngulf was already computed in v37 and never wired to anything.
notes: PF 0.7051283 on 255 trades, 13.73% win rate against an rr of 2.0 that needs 33% to break even. The pure mirror does not work on BTC. BUT THIS IS THE MOST INFORMATIVE SHORT FAILURE THE LAB HAS PRODUCED, for three reasons. (1) It is the first short built from the source's LITERAL statement rather than an invented geometry -- v34's 0.736 was a fade-into-the-zone construction nobody in the source described -- so it closes the mirror hypothesis SPECIFICALLY rather than vaguely. (2) IT POINTS DIRECTLY AT WHAT IS MISSING, AND IT IS MISSING FROM BOTH LEGS: the source says repeatedly that the model IS the higher timeframe ('the model is just going to be the same thing that the hard time frame is', [05:12]; a break down is distribution in a bearish context and redistribution in a bullish one, throughout 04-18-22). v37 IMPLEMENTS NO BIAS GATE AT ALL. So this build shorted supply zones straight through the 2023-2025 bull advance -- exactly what the source forbids -- and the 13.73% win rate is what that looks like. The champion has been getting away with the omission because a long-only strategy in a rising market does not need a bias gate to avoid the worst trades; the short leg cannot. (3) TECHNICAL FLAG, SECOND SIGHTING: cascadeRatio 1.4655 -- 255 rows from 174 unique entries, max depth 4. v51 showed the same signature at 1.419. The one-entry-per-zone latch is not holding on the short side, so the headline is computed over more rows than there were entries. This must be understood before ANY short number from this lab is believed, including this one. || CASCADE SIGNATURE RESOLVED 2026-09-04 by free trade-level decomposition of all 255 rows (get_trades on jobId 01M1KMEZKG6JJ45FKGW23MVDNJ), grouping by (entryBar, entryPrice). THE LATCH IS NOT BROKEN -- that premise was wrong. 255 rows come from 174 unique entries, depth distribution 107/54/12/1, and EVERY row inside a multi-row group shares the SAME entryBar AND the SAME entryPrice. There is only ever one entry per zone; the multiplicity is entirely on the EXIT side. The first row of a multi-row group is always a SLIVER: median 2.28% of the position's total size, max 7.34%, and under 10% in 100% of the 67 groups. All 148 multi-rows are SHORT, and in 64.2% of groups each successive exit is at an equal-or-worse price. That is a MARGIN-CALL UNWIND -- the engine sheds a sliver to meet margin as the short moves adverse, then closes the remainder later. HARD LESSONS 34 and 35 confirmed at trade level rather than inferred. WHAT IT DOES AND DOES NOT CONTAMINATE: PF by rows 0.70512830 vs PF BY ENTRY 0.70360999 -- a difference of 0.0015, so the profit factor was never distorted and short PFs from this lab ARE believable. The WIN RATE IS NOT: 13.73% by rows becomes 20.11% BY ENTRY, because the sliver rows are almost always losses and inflate the loss count. Every short win rate this lab has quoted is understated by roughly 6pp. Liquidated entries average -$15.32 against -$13.59 for clean ones, so the unwind is not the source of the loss either. THE DECISIVE NUMBER IS GROSS: -$895.26 before a cent of commission, against $1,585.06 of commission. THE 3M SHORT LOSES MONEY AT ZERO COST. That closes the 'it is just fees' reading and makes the mirror a mechanism failure, not a harness artifact.

name: 3M Elite v54: bias gate (12H & 24H model direction) added to the v37 champion, LONG
description: Queue item 1 from v53/HARD LESSON 32: implement the 12H/24H model-direction bias gate the source specifies ("the model is just going to be the same thing that the hard time frame is", [05:12]) and re-run the LONG leg against it, one change from the v37 champion (PF 1.25172059 / DD 8.72815312% / 155 trades). Bias defined by the lab's own already-used mechanical rule (consecutive higher/lower closes on the reconstructed TF, from v1 and SYSTEM.md's mechanical table), applied to 12H and 24H per the shape table, both required to agree bullish.
notes: THE LONG LEG'S NUMBERS MOVED, CONFIRMING HARD LESSON 32. Adding the 12H/24H bias gate (both timeframes must agree bullish, everything else held at v37) took PF 1.25172059 -> 1.15861551, drawdown 8.72815312% -> 9.03845822% (+0.31pp, worse), and trade count 155 -> 48 (a 69% cut). RATCHET v2 clause 1 (PF must improve) fails outright, so this change is REVERTED and v37 remains champion unchanged. But the result answers the queue's real question: part of v37's headline WAS the bull market. The gate removes exactly the trades that fired when the 4H demand-zone mechanism was right but the 12H/24H model was not yet aligned -- and those trades were, on net, carrying real edge (PF was higher WITHOUT the gate), which is consistent with the zone mechanism itself being sound and the source's bias condition being stricter than what this instrument's price action needed over this window. v37 is therefore promoted from champion to champion-with-a-now-MEASURED-caveat: its 1.25172059 is a blend of gated-would-pass and gated-would-fail trades, not a number the bias gate improves on. Cascade is clean here (48 rows = 48 unique entries, ratio 1.0) -- the cascade-signature issue (see v55 and the ledger) is specific to short builds.

name: 3M Elite v55: bias gate (12H & 24H model direction) added to the v53 supply-zone mirror, SHORT
description: Queue item 1 from v53/HARD LESSON 32, short leg: same 12H/24H bias gate as v54, added to v53 (the exact structural mirror of the v37 champion), both bias timeframes required to agree bearish. Judged against v53's PF 0.70512830 / DD 31.07505566% / 255 rows (174 unique entries) under RATCHET v2.
verdict: REJECTED -- RATCHET v2 clause 4 split test now run, and it fails
notes: THE BIAS GATE HELPS THE SHORT LEG, BUT DOES NOT FIX IT. Versus v53: profit factor 0.70512830 -> 0.72183885 (improved, but by only 0.017 -- under the 0.02 threshold clause 2's drawdown band needs, though clause 2 is moot here since drawdown IMPROVED, not worsened). Drawdown fell sharply: 31.07505566% -> 14.65750079%, a 16.4pp improvement. Trade count fell from 174 unique entries (255 rows) to 62 unique entries (90 rows) -- a 64% cut on either basis, which is >50% and triggers RATCHET v2 clause 4: a split test is required BEFORE this can be kept, not after. THE CASCADE SIGNATURE IS RESOLVED (see STRATEGY-LEDGER.md): 90 rows from 62 unique entries, ratio 1.4516, matches the same signature seen in v51 (1.419) and v53 (1.4655) -- all short builds, confirmed to be the parity engine reporting each partial-exit fill of a single bracket order as its own trade-list row, not a latch failure or re-entry storm; profitFactor/netProfit are unaffected (dollar sums), totalTrades/winRatePct/avgBars* are row-level and should be read alongside uniqueEntries on short builds going forward. SPLIT TEST NOW RUN (see 3m-elite-v55-split-h1 / -h2): H1 (2022-01-01 to 2024-06-08) PF 0.63003790 on 62 rows/38 unique entries, DD 11.97717238%, win rate 9.68% -- FAILS PF 1.0 badly, worse even than v53's own unsplit 0.70512830. H2 (2024-06-08 to 2026-09-01) PF 1.43721863 on 28 rows/24 unique entries, DD 2.67541071%, win rate 21.43% -- clears 1.0 comfortably. 38+24=62 unique entries exactly partitions the full sample's 62, confirming a clean split with no boundary double-count. THE VERDICT: clause 4 requires a split test BEFORE promotion, and this one is a clear fail -- the aggregate PF of 0.72183885 is not a stable number, it is a blend of a badly losing bear/recovery half and a modestly winning recent half, the same concentration-in-one-half shape RATCHET v2 was written to catch. REJECTED, not kept, not promoted. Champion remains v37, long-only, unchanged. The short leg's status across every construction tried (v34, v51, v53, v55) is now: none has passed a split test; the bias gate is a real, measured improvement over the raw mirror but does not rescue the leg.

description: RATCHET v2 clause 4 (v55's trade count fell >50% vs v53) requires a split test before any keep decision. Byte-identical Pine to pine/3m-elite-v55-bias-gate-short.pine, only the backtest window changed, split at 2024-06-08 exactly as v37 was split-tested.

name: 3M v57: the bias gate made CONDITIONAL, as the source actually specifies
description: Queue item 1 asked which of two readings was right, and the transcripts answer it: the gate as implemented in v54/v55 is TOO STRICT. transcripts/2026-08-09 04-18-22.txt [01:44] 'anything that has the word ADVANCED in it means that we need to check the higher time frame', and [02:41] the reason is that 'if things are going back and forth... the next break could be either direction'. So the higher-timeframe bias is a TIE-BREAKER FOR AN AMBIGUOUS STRUCTURE, not a blanket filter -- and [00:38] says 'one one one' is explicitly NOT advanced. v54 applied it to every entry. ONE CHANGE from v54: the 12H/24H bias applies only when the current run of same-direction completed 4H candles is 2-3 long, matching the source's own 'two two two / three three three' advanced forms. Everything else held byte-identical to v54/v37.
verdict: REJECTED -- the gate binds, is better implemented conditionally, and still costs edge
notes: THE SECOND OF FIVE PRE-REGISTERED OUTCOMES LANDED. THE GATE BINDS AND IS NOT INERT: 125 trades sits cleanly between v54's 48 (universal gate) and v37's 155 (no gate), exactly the range the header named in advance as the evidence that the conditional term does real work. AND THE FAITHFUL IMPLEMENTATION BEATS THE STRICT ONE: 1.17083258 against v54's 1.15861551, on 2.6x the sample (125 vs 48). Reading the transcripts before trusting a mechanisation was worth a credit. BUT NEITHER BEATS v37 WITH NO GATE AT ALL (1.25172059 / 8.72815312% / 155). REJECTED under RATCHET v2 clause 1: PF falls and drawdown worsens 8.73% -> 10.41%. THE CLAIM THAT MUST NOW BE WITHDRAWN: SYSTEM.md has been carrying 'part of v37s headline was the bull market, now measured rather than suspected', on the strength of v54. THAT IS WITHDRAWN. It rested on a gate that does not match the source, and the faithful version does not support it either. THE EVIDENCE ACTUALLY POINTS THE OTHER WAY, and the logic is worth stating: the gate KEEPS trades whose 12H/24H context is bullish and DROPS the rest. If v37s edge were merely the bull market, dropping the non-bull-confirmed trades should have RAISED profit factor. It LOWERED it, twice, under two different implementations -- which means the trades removed were profitable on average, and the strategy earns in non-bullish higher-timeframe contexts too. That is suggestive rather than conclusive, because the gate also shifts occupancy (LESSONS 24/28/29) and a different admitted population is not a controlled subset. But it is the opposite of what the withdrawn claim asserted. THIS IS THE THIRD SOURCE-INVERSION IN THE PROJECT: War Formation E64b found the source's literal 6h direction rule loses to the lab's proxy, E69a found the 1h term the source calls 'a bonus' is load-bearing, and now 3M finds the higher-timeframe bias the source insists on costs edge on this instrument. ENGINE NOTE (new constraint): the first version used ta.sum over a flip marker and the engine rejected it -- 'unimplemented function ta.sum'. Rejected at validation before execution, so no credit was spent; the run-length formulation that replaced it is array-free AND closer to the source's own wording. CASCADE: ratio 1, so 125 is a true position count (HARD LESSON 35) and clause 3 applies to it directly.

name: 3M Elite v58: entry restricted to dzTouch==0 (first touch of a never-touched zone), one change from champion v37
description: This cycle's two named queue items (the 12H/24H bias gate, the cascade signature) are both already done as of v54/v55/v56/v57 and the concurrent liquidation-unwind closure -- per 'THE DOCS WIN over this prompt', this cycle continues the real open queue instead. The last SYSTEM.md entry (v37 cost decomposition + HARD LESSON 38 cross-lab warning) named the most promising untried lever as anything that raises gross edge per trade WITHOUT lengthening holds, and explicitly warned off a single-variable rTarget widen (13.5% of v37's trades already sit at maxBars=96). dzTouch < 2 (the One Candle Rule mitigation cap) has been a KILL condition since v13 but was never tested as an ENTRY-time selectivity filter distinct from that role: v37 currently allows entry on a zone that already absorbed one completed-4H body-close-inside (dzTouch==1, a 'used' zone under the One Candle Rule) as well as a genuinely untouched one (dzTouch==0). This restricts entry to dzTouch==0 only -- a pure entry-quality filter touching neither stop, target, nor maxBars, so it cannot lengthen holds by construction. PRE-RUN AUDIT (LESSON 17): R floor unchanged 0.8% (LESSON 3); stop unchanged dzBot, structural (LESSON 5); long-only, matches champion scope (LESSON 6 -- this is a champion-scope selectivity test, not a new short-side idea, so it does not violate v56's standing instruction against further short-mirror parameter tweaks); BINDING (E17): dzTouch==0 is a strict subset of dzTouch<2, so trade count must fall or stay flat -- if it did not fall the term would never have been binding at the dzTouch==1 margin; REDUNDANCY (E14): no other conjunction term measures completed-body-close count, so this is not implied by anything already present (unlike close>dzBot, shown redundant at v44). PREDICTION stated before running: trade count falls from 155 (some v37 entries currently fire on dzTouch==1 zones); if a genuinely untested zone converts at a materially higher rate than a once-touched one, PF should rise on the smaller sample; if a zone that already survived one completed close-inside is in fact the more reliable signal, PF could fall instead -- either way the exit mechanics are completely unchanged, so any PF move is attributable to entry quality alone, not to a longer or shorter hold.
verdict: RATCHET v2 clauses 1-3 PASS decisively; clause 4 (mandatory split) not triggered but not yet checked -- new interior base, promotion to champion-of-record pending a split test
notes: THE PREDICTION'S FIRST BRANCH LANDED, DECISIVELY. Versus champion v37: profit factor 1.25172059 -> 1.48439273 (+0.2327, far past the 0.02 threshold), max drawdown 8.72815312% -> 8.70519440% (IMPROVED, not just held), trades 155 -> 117 (a 24.5% cut -- real but under RATCHET v2 clause 4's 50% split-test trigger). All three live ratchet clauses (PF up, DD not worse, count >=30) pass at once, which last happened for this lab at v32 and v37 themselves. WHY IT WORKED AS DESIGNED: avgBarsWinning is 47.02 (49% of the 96-bar cap), essentially identical to v37's own 47.0 (49%) -- the hold profile is unchanged, confirming the entry-only filter did not achieve its PF gain by lengthening winners into the cap, exactly the lever HARD LESSON 38 said was untried and safest. Achieved win/loss ratio (HARD LESSON 39) is 1.73179151 against the same nominal rTarget=2.0 -- 86.6% of nominal, weaker than v37's 97.1% but still healthy, and win rate rose from 42.58% to 46.15%. Net effect: a genuinely untouched zone (dzTouch==0) converts at a higher rate than a zone that already absorbed one completed close-inside, which is the opposite of 'a zone that survived a test is proven' and consistent with the source's own framing of a fresher setup as a cleaner one. Cascade ratio 1.0 (117 rows = 117 unique entries) -- clean, as expected for a long build (HARD LESSON 35's tranching signature is short-specific). NOT YET A CHAMPION: this is a >24% trade-count cut on a large PF move, and while RATCHET v2's clause 4 does not mandate a split test below 50%, this lab has never promoted a result of this magnitude to 'passed' without one (v32->v33, v37->v39) -- the credit budget this cycle (1 of 2 spent on this run) did not extend to a same-cycle split, so v58 is recorded as the new interior base (status: testing) and the split (2022-01-01/2024-06-08 halves, matching the established methodology) is the top queue item for the next cycle before any promotion.
